plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Levent GRH 与自然扩张 · QP-0080 · 切换首次因子后保留二次余因子的判别式与筛条件
plain_statement.en: New route · Levent GRH and natural extensions · QP-0080 · Preserve the discriminant and sieve conditions after switching out a first factor

brief.zh: 在实际根 r 上写 k=pt+r。除掉 p 后判别式恒为 −16；与 p 互素的旧筛条件保持等价。此式用在最小因子 p 的内层和。
brief.en: Write k=pt+r at an actual root r. Removing p leaves discriminant −16 and preserves sieve conditions coprime to p. This supplies the inner sum with least factor p.
